notes.title: Geballer: Launch and Future!
notes.content:
Thanks!
I want to start this by thanking all of your for your Support of Geballer! It has been very great to see your reviews & levels & suggestions!

The Good
We are pretty happy with the game itself as well! It seems to do exactly what it was supposed to do :)
 
The Bad
As usual, the main problem is reaching a large enough audience. 
As usual, I (josh) kind of dropped the ball on that by not doing enough marketing / failing to send out keys to all the streamers, etc. We made sure to keep all of development as stress-free as possible, but, as usual, the end was a bit of a mess for me. 

The Future
[We have taken a little break and will now work on adding some small improvements and some new features to the game. 

Once this update is done, I will rally my spirits once more to try and be a good marketing person. Getting the game in front of as many people as possible will be priority number 1. If that goes well, we will be able to afford to spend more time on the game, making it even nicer :)

Thanks again!
Your support on twitter and steam has been super incredible so far and we are very thankful for your contributions to our little project <3. This was always meant to be a small collaboration and it is very cool to see that it actually achieved most of it's goals! Thanks!

We hope that you will enjoy the update and wish you all a nice day!

Cheers!
